name: Vault of Enigma
description: A 5-day pack event. Buy one chest each day, and if you bought all 5 you can choose a reward at the end.

phases.name: Daily chests
phases.description: You must buy each chest every day. After 5 days, if you bought all 5 chests, you can choose one reward from those shown in the screenshot.

tips: The chest and reward lists are shown on the wiki only as images.
